The Mia Health App uses PAI to measure your activity. PAI is short for Personal Activity Intelligence. You earn PAI every time your heart rate increases, no matter which type of physical activity you choose to do. Research from the Nobel Prize winning Faculty of Medicine and the Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) shows that those who stay at or above 100 PAI have markedly lower risk of lifestyle diseases such as a heart attack, dementia and obesity.

The Mia Health app can give you the status of your physical fitness by estimating your VO₂ max and fitness age.

Your VO₂ max is one of the best indicators of your overall health. Mia Health estimates VO₂ max with NTNU's validated Fitness Calculator and uses artificial intelligence and PAI score to update your VO₂ max over time.

Your fitness age is calculated from your VO₂ max to let you know how old your body is. The lower your fitness age, the more protected you are from developing lifestyle diseases such as heart attack, depression, dementia, and several types of cancer.
